data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 榻榻米间的神圣求子宣言
data.description: 卧室内制服纽扣完全解开，露出雪白诱人的肩颈。伊莉娜双手在胸前合十，满面绯红但眼神极其认真地注视着你，带着小颤音宣告“为了天主，今晚要和一诚君生下圣剑的孩子”。
data.location: traditional Japanese bedroom with tatami and sliding doors
data.action: kneeling on tatami, unbuttoned uniform shirt exposing bare shoulders, praying hands at chest, blushing furiously, breathless loving gaze
data.lighting: warm amber ambient lantern light casting tender shadows on bare skin
data.mood: innocent erotic earnestness, pure holy devotion, heart-racing gap moe
data.promptProse: Kneeling on tatami with an unbuttoned uniform, Irina blushes fiercely with praying hands, declaring her pure love with breathless amber eyes.
data.animaCaption: Irina kneeling on tatami with an open uniform shirt declaring her love.
